summary: Regression testing completed: backend suite passed 5/5; browser verified app load, XP summary selector, mission repeat stability, profile controls, community chat, private chat, and role switching with no page errors.
action_items: For a clean XP-award verification, reset or isolate mission seed data before the next test run.
seed_data_creation: No new seed records created; existing shared demo state contained completed missions and prior chat test messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested UI flows passed. Mission-6 was already complete in shared persistence, so the API probe verified repeated completion returns zero XP but could not observe a fresh first award in this run.
rca of the issue: The only probe assertion failure was test-state related: mission-6 had progress equal to its goal before the test, causing both calls to return already_completed=true and xp=0. This confirms idempotent behavior but prevents validating the initial award transition without isolated/reset data.
